bundle.shortDescription: Local audiobook player with resume, speed control, and SQLite-backed progress.
bundle.longDescription: ChapterCheck is a Linux desktop player for long-form audio: open a folder as a playlist, sort tracks, adjust speed, and resume where you left off. Playback uses mpv; your library paths and positions stay on disk under your user profile.
